full_name: Melani Cammett | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Social Sciences Perrin Moorhead Grayson and Bruns Grayson Fellow Harvard University
bio: Melani Cammett is a political scientist who specializes in ethnic politics, conflict, and development. At Radcliffe, she will write a book on how people live together after violence, focusing on Bosnia-Herzegovina, Lebanon, and Northern Ireland.
